Create a high detail realistic tactical game sprite PARTS ATLAS, square 2048 x 2048 if possible, exactly a clean 2 by 2 grid, four equal cells. Actual transparent background, no floor, NO labels or borders. If alpha impossible use pure flat #ff00ff only.
Reference 1 establishes MAGPIE olive rolled sleeves, tan gear, realistic dorsal overhead viewpoint; correct the arms/weapon, do not copy its gun. Reference 2 is manufacturer's L119A2 silhouette and receiver reference, NOT a sprite to paste: render its SHORT CQB variant from directly OVERHEAD, muzzle pointing RIGHT, black continuous integrated receiver/handguard, tan stock and pistol grip, compact black optic. It must retain a straight rail and slim rigid barrel. No broadside magazine visible from above.
All FOUR cells share EXACTLY SAME pixel registration, scale, 90-degree directly overhead orthographic camera and pose. ONE stationary right-handed aimed standing pose, not walking. Feet planted under hips, slight fore-aft stagger, knees not splayed; natural elbow bends, shoulders slightly squared to right. In every cell's local normalized coordinates, head centre at (37%,49%), shoulder line behind it; gun stock starts (39%,53%), receiver/grip at (61%,53%), support hand at (75%,53%), muzzle (94%,53%). Head can partially occlude stock. The operator's RIGHT arm appears on screen BOTTOM, reaches rear pistol grip near receiver. His LEFT arm appears on screen TOP, reaches forward handguard. Natural two hands only, fingers wrapped on grips, rifle butt pressed into right shoulder. Keep upper forearm visible to read accurate contact. Magnified detail for gear and glove contact.
TOP LEFT CELL: ONLY complete unarmoured base body: olive combat shirt with rolled sleeves, trousers, boots, exposed forearms, short hair. No vest, helmet, pouches, firearm, gloves or hands. Forearms end naturally at wrist under where glove cuffs will overlay (not gore, just modular cutout).
TOP RIGHT CELL: ONLY removable tan helmet and olive/tan plate carrier with modest back pouches. Exactly where they belong atop the same body. No head, arms, legs, weapon or phantom body. Helmet on top of carrier, correctly dorsal TOP view, carrier shoulders draping naturally.
BOTTOM LEFT CELL: ONLY complete short L119A2 rifle WITH two black-gloved hands accurately gripping it, glove cuffs included. No arms or body. Same physical gun position and registration as the other cells. Support glove overlaps side/top of fore-end naturally; right glove around rear pistol grip below receiver. No extra hands or floating magazines. The rigid gun is a reusable component; hands are its weapon-specific contact component.
BOTTOM RIGHT CELL: the FULL ASSEMBLY of those EXACT SAME three layers, same positioning, no redesign. This is reference preview only. It should look like a coherent standing operator holding a properly shouldered rifle, entirely true overhead: crown of helmet and shoulders dominate, neither upright chest nor face visible. Clear readable materials, restrained realistic highlights, no exaggerated outlines. All components fully within each cell with 5% padding. Anatomy and matching registration take priority over ornament. NO second pose, no smoke or firing, no text.

master:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE high-resolution master sprite of MAGPIE for modular extraction, not a contact sheet. Reference 1 supplies olive rolled-sleeve uniform, tan helmet, plate carrier and natural overhead body textures. Reference 2 supplies EXACT SHORT L119A2 model (bottom rifle) with black integrated receiver/handguard and tan stock/grip. Render the weapon from the character's overhead camera, not broadside.
A competent right-handed operator standing and aiming a short carbine straight UP, viewed from directly above at 90 degrees, orthographic. Single character, exactly two arms and two legs. Body occupies lower two thirds, rifle extends into upper third. Head is slightly LEFT of rifle line: the gun's tan buttstock meets his RIGHT shoulder on screen RIGHT of neck, cheek close to stock, firing right hand immediately in front of that shoulder under receiver, support LEFT hand reaching forward onto handguard. NO rifle through centre of helmet. NO stock projecting down from chest or hanging like a second gun. Arms are NOT symmetric: left hand distinctly farther forward than right. Natural bent elbows close to torso, relaxed stable stance with boots below hips, small stagger, NOT kneeling, NOT prone, NOT running.
Visible TOP rail and TOP of slim compact optic, top of narrow tan stock, short black straight muzzle device; optic and rail axis match barrel axis. No gigantic scope, no belt-fed equipment. Tan helmet has LOW PROFILE bare front mount, no protruding night vision tube: the optic belongs ON THE RIFLE, not on helmet.
MAGPIE realistic olive shirt, rolled sleeves, exposed forearms, black five-finger gloves, tan helmet, olive/tan plate carrier with compact radio and back pouch, muted teal small arm identification. Practical proportions, readable correct firearm anatomy and shoulder contact. Soft overhead neutral light, sharp photoreal material treatment but not oversharpened. Camera is precisely above standing human, crown dominates, shoulders and small tops of boots visible, no vertical chest portrait. Full body and entire muzzle inside 8% padding. Pure solid #ff00ff background with no shadow, no text. 1536x1536 or higher.
